resources.string: Your phone, on your car screen.
Mirror your phone to this screen or to the cluster / HUD.\nOpen Xiaomi CarWith, OPPO Car+ or vivo Jovi InCar on your phone and pick this car to start.
Keep Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on. Open Xiaomi CarWith, OPPO Car+ or vivo Jovi InCar on your phone, tap this car, then check the pairing code shown here.
Pair this car in your phone’s Bluetooth settings first.
Pair your phone with the car first. Return here when pairing is complete.
Turn on Bluetooth in the car’s settings to connect your phone.
Connection, display and sound — all in one place.
Start with your car and reconnect to your phone.
Picture size, frame rate and audio settings.
Check Bluetooth, microphone and location access.
Changes to video settings apply on your next connection.
Tune your display, sound and connection.
Keep music with the car’s Bluetooth player. Car++ leaves its audio focus alone; navigation and assistant audio remain available. Reconnect after changing this.
